rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides integration with Typebot, a chatbot platform, enabling programmatic management of chatbots through authentication and bot management tools. Built by Osdeibi Acurero using TypeScript and the MCP SDK, it connects to Typebot's API using workspace tokens for authentication and allows users to interact with their Typebot instances. The implementation includes environment variable configuration for secure token management and supports operations for managing chatbot workflows, making it useful for developers who want to integrate Typebot functionality into AI assistants or automate chatbot management tasks.
